author: Gene Holcombe
text:
Which sensor are you trying to apply?  Each one is slightly different.  Are you using Libre 1,2,2+,3,3+?

You will have to apply it to your skin and press hard and hold it to allow the sensor and adhesive to firmly attach to your skin.  It doesn't hurt. even though it looks scary.  If you dont push hard and hold, then you can get to a situation where it falls off.  It's the most common mistake made by most users.
